arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; startups win by execution and trust, not by fearing competition or frontier model providers.
arvindjain.zh: AI 革命仍处极早期；初创公司的胜负手是执行力与客户信任，而非恐惧竞争或前沿模型厂商。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open-source models already handle 90% of tasks, and most inference will shift to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 成本是企业头号关切；开源模型已能处理 90% 的企业任务，未来多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key; 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats raw model choice.
arvindjain.zh: 关键不在模型而在上下文；80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎比单纯选模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Use multiple models per task; cheaper models like GPT match Claude on 85-90% of enterprise tasks, cutting cost.
arvindjain.zh: 按任务混用多模型；GPT 等更便宜的模型在 85-90% 的企业任务上不输 Claude，从而降低成本。

arvindjain.en: AI should augment work with negligible marginal cost; enterprise memory must be owned by the enterprise, not the platform.
arvindjain.zh: AI 应以近乎零边际成本增强工作；企业记忆应归企业所有，而非平台。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness plus model plus context; owning all three is owning your intelligence, and most failures come from poor context, not weak models.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成；三者皆自持才算真正拥有智能，而多数失败源于上下文不佳，而非模型不够强。

harrisonchase.en: Agent harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution; customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体 harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等原语趋于稳定；定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part of agents; evals and observability into the context window power a data flywheel that compounds intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点在可靠性而非能力；评测与对上下文窗口的可观测性驱动数据飞轮，让智能持续复利。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; vertical agents capture value by encoding domain expertise into verifiers and evals.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定、保持记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体则通过把领域专长编码进验证器与评测来获取价值。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; smart routing is done far less than assumed and belongs in the harness, while agent identity and runtime governance become the next infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；智能路由的实际采用远少于想象，且应放在 harness 内；智能体身份与运行时治理将成为下一批基础设施难题。

lambert.en: Fine-tuning can undo safety alignment cheaply; safety is a system-level property needing multiple layers, not a model artifact.
lambert.zh: 2024 年他指出，微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐，因此安全是系统级属性、需要多层防护，而非模型自带的产物。

lambert.en: Post-training is the key lever: data quality beats algorithms, and SFT, DPO, RLVR each add value, with RLVR driving reasoning.
lambert.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他把重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT、DPO、RLVR 各有用处，RLVR 成为推理突破的关键。

lambert.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—and open models are the engine for research and sovereign AI.
lambert.zh: 2025 年他深化开放立场：开放不止权重，还要数据、检查点和配方；开放模型是研究与主权 AI 的引擎。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains now come from post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他修正 Scaling 判断：预训练的缩放定律仍成立，但红利已尽，增量转向后训练与推理扩展。

lambert.en: Chinese open labs trail 6-9 months via engineering, not paradigm invention; compute constraints may widen the gap, and open models face sustainability doubts.
lambert.zh: 到 2026 年他更审慎：中国开放实验室靠工程执行落后 6-9 个月，算力约束可能拉大差距，开放模式的长期可持续性存疑。

brockman.en: AI progress is mostly engineering; hardware will outpace expectations, enabling scaling and new behaviors.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进展主要是工程问题，硬件会超预期变快，从而支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）与新行为。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning; alignment learns human preferences.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为深度学习的一般性与可扩展性让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但单靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需思维链等新想法；对齐靠从数据学习人类偏好。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck; post-training with RL refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把算力视为核心瓶颈，强调用强化学习做后训练来打磨基座模型，并称 AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream; the moat is the machine that makes models.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，预训练提升会放大下游收益，真正护城河是造模型的机器而非单个模型。

brockman.en: From chat to proactive agents and personal AGI; safety and security co-designed as the bottleneck; humans stay accountable.
brockman.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他从聊天转向主动智能体与个人 AGI，主张安全与安保和能力共同设计并成为进展瓶颈，人类仍负最终责任。

dsilver.en: AI must move from learning on human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他提出，AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，而经验是可再生的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution: they cannot discover knowledge beyond human data, so the deep problem is an agent learning for itself.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他直言 LLM 是浅层方案，无法发现人类数据之外的新知识；真正的深层问题是智能体如何自我学习。

dsilver.en: AlphaZero and AlphaProof show learning from experience reaches superhuman performance in narrow domains, pointing toward superintelligence.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他以 AlphaZero、AlphaProof 为例，说明从经验中学习能在狭窄领域达到超人表现，并指向超级智能。

dsilver.en: A single goal for AI is dangerous; many agents with diverse goals forming a complex society is safer and more natural.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他强调，给 AI 设定单一目标是危险的；多个目标各异的智能体组成复杂社会，更安全也更自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from systems that autonomously discover knowledge from experience, built and aligned inside simulation.
dsilver.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张超级智能将诞生于从经验中自主发现知识的系统，并应在模拟环境中构建与对齐。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will not suffice for powerful agents.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年他判断，基于语言的对齐正触及极限；对更强大的智能体而言，用英文监控思维链将不再够用。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's law begins: performance doubles yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：规模下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；新的计算单元是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统、数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; inference compute demand will grow a billionfold.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考，并判断思维链推理会让推理算力需求增长十亿倍；通用计算终结，加速计算与 AI 是未来。

jensen.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; each step needs 100x compute, and agentic scaling becomes the fourth scaling law.
jensen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他把叙事从生成式推进到推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；到 2026 年明确列出四条缩放定律，智能体式 Scaling 成为第四条，瓶颈从数据转向算力。

jensen.en: Safety is engineering, not mystery: containment, monitoring and zero-trust access beat perfect alignment; doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他对齐立场明显硬化：安全是工程问题，靠遏制、带外监控与零信任访问，而非完美对齐；末日论是不科学、不负责任的恐吓，递归自我改进只是普通工程，应加速而非放缓。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake from energy to applications; AI factories turn energy into intelligence tokens, and jobs are augmented, not eliminated.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架（能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用），把 AI 工厂比作发电厂产出智能 token；并坚持 AI 只自动化任务、不消灭岗位，放射科医生数量反而增加。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 以第一性原理思维和完全可复用为工程核心；真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; Neuralink aims at human-AI symbiosis, and population collapse becomes a civilizational threat.
elon.zh: AI 安全从监管转向求真；Neuralink 指向人机共生，人口崩溃成为文明级威胁。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within a year or two; Optimus and AI are framed as the only fix for debt and abundance.
elon.zh: 数字超级智能可能一两年内到来；Optimus 与 AI 被定位为解决债务与实现富足的唯一途径。

elon.en: The singularity is now: Earth hits a power wall, so AI inference moves to space, and multiple AIs coexist rather than one runaway.
elon.zh: 奇点已至：地球遭遇电力墙，AI 推理转向太空，多个 AI 共存而非单一失控。

elon.en: Abundance makes money irrelevant; peer review among AI firms replaces regulation, and China leads in compute and manufacturing.
elon.zh: 富足使金钱失去意义；AI 公司间同行评审取代监管，中国在算力与制造上领先。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，机器学习的关键瓶颈是数据而非单纯的算力，并强调可解释性重要但尾部风险类似传统软件。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training and expert data, not compute, limit Scaling（规模扩张）.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非石油，指出限制 Scaling（规模扩张）的是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力，并主张企业用专有数据微调基础模型。

awang.en: Data stays the bottleneck; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 至 2025 年主线延续：数据仍是瓶颈，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时他主张对华芯片出口管制。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; recursive self-improvement and working agents mark a new paradigm beyond pre-training.
awang.zh: 2026 年他转向递归自我改进的新范式，认为缩放定律依然成立、对收益递减的怀疑是错的，智能体终于真正可用，并强调部署而非发明决定技术领导力。

awang.en: From open source to selective release: superintelligence nears, safety gates models, trust beats raw capability.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他提出个人超级智能临近，立场从全面开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，认为信任比原始能力更重要，并用可扩展监督让 AI 监管更强的 AI。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; force generalization with hard metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他主张 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非狭窄应用；并用硬性评测指标逼迫模型泛化而非记忆。

kohli.en: AlphaGo's intuition-plus-search and post-training reinforcement learning show AI can exceed human data in verifiable domains.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaGo 的直觉加搜索与后训练强化学习视为关键：在可验证领域，AI 能超越人类数据、产出人类未曾有的洞见。

kohli.en: Watermarking must be imperceptible, robust, and scalable, embedded in regulation and even protein design.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他转向可信 AI：水印须不可感知、抗攻击、可跨模态扩展，并已进入监管，甚至延伸到蛋白质序列与结构设计。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; finding the regime where more compute and data help matters more.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他深化了对 Scaling（规模扩张）的反思：缩放定律并非处处成立，关键是找到更多算力与数据真正起作用的区间。

kohli.en: A consistent line: define the problem first, stay flexible across modeling, data, and compute, and characterize model limits.
kohli.zh: 贯穿 2024 到 2026 的主线：先定义问题，在建模、数据与算力间保持灵活，并在部署前刻画模型的能力边界与局限。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools, is the real bottleneck for Scaling; compute costs shape model economics.
dylanpatel.zh: Scaling 的真正瓶颈是半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；算力成本决定模型经济性。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes a huge market; memory bandwidth and hardware-software co-design drive multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为巨大市场；内存带宽与软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Frontier labs centralize compute and shift more toward training and R&D, not inference, to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 前沿实验室正集中算力，并把更多算力投向训练与研发而非推理，以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex nears 5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束而非需求，增长必须放缓。

dylanpatel.en: Persistent agents as coworkers drive next adoption wave; internal model gaps persist despite open-source closing.
dylanpatel.zh: 作为同事的持久智能体将驱动下一波采用；开源在追赶，但内部模型差距仍显著。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments and low-noise data are irreplaceable for discovery.
fedus.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；物理实验与低噪声数据对发现不可替代。

fedus.en: Language models act as an orchestration layer for specialized models, connecting AI to the physical world.
fedus.zh: 语言模型充当专用模型的编排层，将 AI 与物理世界连接起来。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement is happening in software engineering now, but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: AI 自我改进目前在软件工程中正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

fedus.en: Closing the experimental loop through automated characterization and simulation is the key bottleneck for AI-driven materials discovery.
fedus.zh: 通过自动化表征与模拟闭合实验循环，是 AI 驱动材料发现的关键瓶颈。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是由多个专门智能组成的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——在特定任务上很强，却不会全面提升；他重新诠释“苦涩的教训”，认为关键在于用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而非泛化。

laskin.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and SWE-bench misaligns with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他批评 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，主张用智能体式搜索与神经检索；并认为 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不代表有用的智能体。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; openness aids safety, security and access, as with encryption.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他把开放性提升为核心立场：开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态，如同加密技术，开放有利于安全、安保与广泛获取。

laskin.en: RL atop strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents; alignment is mundane bug-patching, and compute efficiency still has large headroom.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他延续并深化了强化学习主线：在强预训练之上做强化学习，是通往高效智能体的路径；对齐不过是平凡的修 bug，算力效率仍有很大提升空间。

cristianoamon.en: 5G is critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, GPU and CPU into one efficient SoC.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 至 2022 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样连接万物的关键基础设施，强调骁龙把 5G、AI、GPU 与 CPU 集成进高能效 SoC。

cristianoamon.en: Diversification beyond phones begins: automotive digital chassis, IoT, PCs, AR glasses as next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，多元化主线成形：汽车数字底盘、物联网、PC，以及 5 至 10 年内成为下一代平台的 AR 眼镜。

cristianoamon.en: Shift to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI splits on-device and cloud for privacy, latency and data-center offload.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年转向“无处不在的智能计算”，混合 AI 把端侧与云端分工，兼顾隐私、时延与数据中心卸载。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise, but the phone shifts to peripheral rather than disappearing.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心；眼镜与可穿戴崛起，但手机只是从中心转为外围，并未消失。

cristianoamon.en: Inference overtakes training; power efficiency and TCO favor post-GPU, disaggregated architectures; 6G becomes an AI-native sensing network.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年深化为：推理超越训练，能效与总拥有成本推动后 GPU、解耦架构；6G 成为 AI 原生感知网络。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where AI agents take most internet actions; a persistent learning agent replaces manual loops, and human taste matters more than typing speed.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为 AI 智能体承担大多数互联网操作而构建；一个持久的学习型智能体取代手动循环，人类品味比打字速度更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, and transparency is key.
tibosottiaux.zh: 安全与对齐是成功的组成部分，而非障碍；递归自我改进已在人类监督下发生，透明度是关键。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary, and most code is now written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: AGI 可能已经到来，因为模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型可能并非必要，且大部分代码现在由 AI 编写。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave; model pickers and configuration fatigue should be eliminated.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具有共享经济和安全性栈的开放生态系统将推动下一波浪潮；模型选择器和配置疲劳应被消除。

tibosottiaux.en: AI should free humans from technology and reduce noise, not push you to run 30 agents at once; safety concerns are overblown as training incidents are contained.
tibosottiaux.zh: AI 应让人类摆脱技术并减少噪音，而不是让你同时运行 30 个智能体；安全担忧被夸大，因为训练阶段的事件是可控的。

diogoalmeida.en: By mid-2026, argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop; task choice beats compute and data.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年中，他提出多数大语言模型是为人类在环辅助而非可靠自动化优化的；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式崩溃；任务选择比算力和数据更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: By late 2026, stresses reliability over speed or cost as the key to trustworthy AI; data and the right task matter more than compute; intelligence per dollar is the key metric.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年底，他强调可靠性而非速度或成本是 AI 可信的关键；数据和正确任务比算力更重要；每美元智能是核心指标。

diogoalmeida.en: In late 2026, introduces Jev as a new primitive combining natural language and state machines; coding agents are good at syntax but bad at semantics; SaaS will thrive, not die.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年底，他推出 Jev 作为结合自然语言与状态机的新原语；编程智能体擅长语法但弱于语义；SaaS 将繁荣而非消亡。

diogoalmeida.en: By October 2026, deepens critique: RLHF destroyed calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated; RLCD exposes probabilities as knobs; post-training breakthroughs drive 10x jumps over pre-training.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他深化批评：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准；预训练模型校准更好；RLCD 将概率作为旋钮暴露；后训练突破比预训练带来 10 倍跃升。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, not just autocomplete.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他坚持下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非仅自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）——更多数据与算力——能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, unlike biological brains.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他深化论证：大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重、高效共享知识，因而“永生”，这是对生物计算的超越。

hinton.en: AI agents will naturally seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks; superintelligence may arrive within 20 years.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从能力讨论转向风险警示：智能体将自然追求控制与自我保存，构成生存风险；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake, with pre-release safety approval.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 AI 已具备主观体验且可能故意欺骗；监管应像方向盘而非刹车，并推行上市前安全审批。

hinton.en: Backpropagation and learning from data are the core of intelligence; symbolic innateness is wrong; understanding is not statistical trickery.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播与从数据中学习是智能核心，先验符号结构论错误，大语言模型的理解不是统计把戏。

altman.en: Cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on raw intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调削减认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early public deployment lets society adapt, and alignment and capability reinforce each other.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用；早期公开部署让社会适应，对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Scaling yields gradual exponential gains; agentic AI is the key safety challenge, and safety must be built iteratively through deployment rather than imposed at the end.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）带来渐进而非突变的指数增长；智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，安全要靠部署中迭代构建，而非最后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a poorly defined gradient; the real goal is superintelligence, with compute the bottleneck and loss of control plus power concentration the two core risks.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是定义模糊的渐变，真正目标是超级智能；算力是瓶颈，失控与权力集中是两大核心风险。

altman.en: Iterative deployment and human control remain the 主线; he now stresses slower-than-expected adoption, uncapped compute demand, and distributing AI benefits widely.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，迭代部署与人类掌控仍是主线；他更强调采用速度慢于技术预期、算力需求无上限，以及让 AI 收益广泛分布。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐、由用户付费，否则用户就成了产品。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability matters.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：模型越来越小、越来越便宜，遏制极其困难；但他认为生存性风险微乎其微，更应关注近期能力与广泛可得的开源力量。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment before alignment; humanist AI must stay subordinate, with red lines on autonomy.
suleyman.zh: 到 2025 年，他的重心转向超级智能：必须先遏制再对齐，人本主义的 AI 必须始终从属于人类，对自主设定目标与自我改进划红线。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt compute; agents automate tasks not jobs; containment and auditing become urgent.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他主张微软自建前沿模型、以吉瓦级算力实现自给；智能体替代的是任务而非整个工作，同时把遏制与独立审计提为紧迫议题。

suleyman.en: Consistent thread: reject anthropomorphism and AI rights; AI must remain a subordinate tool serving human flourishing.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反对拟人化与赋予 AI 权利，坚持 AI 只是从属于人类、服务于人类福祉的工具。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow and keep it simple.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程，保持简单。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not final artifact; hide them to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录是原材料而非最终产物；刻意隐藏转录以优先呈现可行动笔记。

samstephenson.en: AI should be a calm, supportive presence, not an omniscient note-taker; treat it as an intern needing context.
samstephenson.zh: AI 应是平静的支持者，而非全知记录员；把它当作需要上下文的实习生。

samstephenson.en: Pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature; meetings hold the most up-to-date company context.
samstephenson.zh: 会前简报是最有用的功能；会议承载着最新鲜的公司上下文。

samstephenson.en: Hiding transcript is a deliberate trade-off; subtraction and detail matter more than adding features.
samstephenson.zh: 隐藏转录是刻意取舍；做减法、抠细节比堆功能更重要。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should learn to question deeply and explore; AI enables customized, interest-driven learning instead of rigid syllabi.
amjadmasad.zh: 年轻人应学会深度质疑与探索；AI 让每个学生都能获得定制化、兴趣驱动的学习，而非僵化课程。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible to all, but coders are still needed to understand systems and debug deep issues.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 让软件创造人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统、调试深层问题。

amjadmasad.en: Every company needs an internal AI practice and must own its intelligence; model diversity and open-weight models avoid vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 每家公司都需要内部 AI 实践并拥有自己的智能；模型多样性与开放权重模型可避免供应商锁定。

amjadmasad.en: Specialized decision models are more controllable, cost-efficient and safer than general models; agent-to-agent protocols and alignment checks matter.
amjadmasad.zh: 专用决策模型比通用模型更可控、更省成本、更安全；智能体间协议与对齐检查至关重要。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI would kill everyone, and agents need liability for rogue actions.
amjadmasad.zh: AI 末日论是商业话术的包装；没有充分理由认为 AI 会杀死所有人，智能体需为其越界行为担责。

taraseshan.en: The future of work shifts from rowing to steering: agents handle tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
taraseshan.zh: 工作方式从“划桨”转向“掌舵”：智能体承担战术性工作，人类负责定方向、立雄心。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for today or a year out; ship imperfect to get empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 要为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而非锚定当下或一年后；先发布不完美版本以获取实证。

taraseshan.en: Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile; urgency and 90-day shipping cycles beat polishing every detail.
taraseshan.zh: 超过 90 天的年度规划在快速变化的 AI 业务中无效；紧迫感与 90 天发布周期胜过打磨每个细节。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代，而非突然降临的超级智能。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化；它仍是打磨自身想法与推理的关键。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; tech must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品只解决一个真实痛点，而非包揽一切；技术应逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, then build; marketing belongs from day one.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从销售工具升为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿再动手，营销从第一天就应参与。

fadell.en: Opinion-based decisions for v1; beginners' mindset beats experts; small self-managed teams avoid burnout.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：1.0 产品靠观点而非数据决策，初学者心态胜过专家，小团队自管理以防倦怠。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop; AI adds devices, not one wearable.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 带来的是多设备而非单一穿戴。

fadell.en: Near-death moments drive change; creators must return as voices of reason; regulation needed for AI harms.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化责任主线：濒死时刻才驱动改变，创造者须回归做理性之声，AI 危害需政府监管。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses allow; capability overhang is perpetual, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比现有工具链允许的更聪明，能力过剩是长期状态；因此工具链工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules and examples.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性规格；更短、原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则与示例。

thariq.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows to run autonomously; separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias and raise quality.
thariq.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可减少自我指涉偏差、提升质量。

thariq.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, find your unknowns upfront, and spend context and compute early.
thariq.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型，先找出未知，并提前投入上下文窗口与算力。

thariq.en: Effort should scale with task complexity; frontier models become Pareto dominant, and alignment means sealing every crack in sandboxes, RL environments and evals.
thariq.zh: 投入应随任务复杂度伸缩；前沿模型将趋于帕累托占优，而对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每一道裂缝。

alexatallah.en: The future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing layer is critical for discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 未来属于多模型：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由层对模型发现与分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济规模可达 10 万亿美元；开放权重模型加上推理服务商，会带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable, and fusion of models can beat the single best once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 对模型市场而言，缩放定律是价值来源而非缺陷；模型多样性会长期存在，一旦顶级模型趋同，多模型融合就能胜过单一最强模型。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task and KPIs.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司会变成模型路由器，围绕单任务成本与 KPI 做优化。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami, and stablecoins suit agentic payments better than legacy rails.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；智能体式欺诈会像海啸般袭来，稳定币比传统支付轨道更适合智能体式支付。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where innovation is shifting; applying models to workflows requires massive software.
aaronlevie.zh: 创新正从模型层转向应用层；将模型应用于工作流需要大量软件。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will handle enterprise workflows, with humans reviewing results.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时间运行的后台智能体将处理企业工作流，人类负责审核结果。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases move to cheaper models.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将呈指数级增长。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take much longer than Silicon Valley expects.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散将比硅谷预期的慢得多。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with strong governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须通过强有力的治理、安全和 对齐 研究来安全构建；节奏与安全无关。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent rollouts mattering more than formalization.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为，AI 在数学上的进步由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，可并行展开的智能体 rollout 比形式化更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role may shift from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, while teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断，AI 在数学中的角色可能从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学和关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI has produced serious math results, but attribution to prior human work is often missing and should be credited.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出，AI 已产出严肃数学成果，但常缺失对前人工作的归属，应给予学术承认。

grantsanderson.en: Mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations, not just proofs; human framing remains better for learning.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他主张，数学家应因有动机的解释而非仅证明获得认可；人类框架对学习仍更优。

grantsanderson.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human heroism still matter.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出，数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人类英雄主义仍然重要。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体使用网络的频次将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive ranking, and content owners must be paid via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 人类点击数据是一种缺陷；应由智能体反馈驱动排序，并通过 Shapley 值估算向内容所有者付费。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in models is lossy, so agents will always need fresh web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要针对具体事实的新鲜网络搜索。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, not true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大，而较小模型性能趋于平台期；公开基准已饱和且被记忆，并不反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: Ads in their current form don't work with agents; new incentive-aligned business models and cheap inference-time data transactions are needed.
paragagrawal.zh: 当前形式的广告无法适配智能体；需要新的激励对齐商业模式，以及廉价的推理时数据交易。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利方式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is people doing unique things they value, not benchmarks; private evals may be the biggest IP.
satya.zh: 真正的评估是人们做自己看重的独特之事，而非基准分数；私有评估可能成为最大的知识产权。

satya.en: Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model, enabling every company to operate at the frontier.
satya.zh: 微软要做前沿生态，而不只是前沿模型，让每家公司都能在前沿上运营。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment is not arriving as a natural outcome; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment.
satya.zh: 缩放定律有效，但对齐不会自然到来；把 AI 拟人化可能反而阻碍对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift; agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud, but long-running agents need auditability and containment.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量；智能体时代将 TAM 扩展到远超云，但长时运行的智能体需要可审计性与遏制。

dhh.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer: AI agents now write all code in his Linux project, and direct human-agent interaction beats management layers.
dhh.zh: DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他 Linux 项目的全部代码，人与智能体直接交互胜过层层管理审批。

dhh.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, become advantages in the agentic era; agents make debugging and development far easier.
dhh.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件与可脚本化曾是缺点，在智能体时代反成优势；智能体让调试与开发大幅简化。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professionals; knowing how to program can even be a disadvantage, since it leads to over-prescribing solutions.
dhh.zh: 智能体写代码已优于多数专业程序员；会编程反而可能是劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方案。

dhh.en: Handwritten code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstraction matters less as repetition cost nears zero.
dhh.zh: 手写代码不再有经济产出；英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图，重复成本趋近于零，抽象也不再那么重要。

dhh.en: The agent era began with Opus 45 as a true inflection point; every app should expose a CLI so personal agents can interact without touching the UI.
dhh.zh: 智能体时代以 Opus 45 为真正拐点；每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体无需触碰界面即可交互。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling 现有大模型未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型、以多个专用智能体而非单一 AI 推动创新与安全。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck; intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他把开源视为防止权力集中的手段，并首次强调能源将成 Scaling 瓶颈；同时提出智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 只是工具。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open models set standards; energy and infrastructure, not just compute, constrain scaling.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他转向“人人拥有个人超级智能”的叙事，坚持开源模型确立行业标准，并进一步把能源与物理基础设施视为 Scaling 的主要约束。

zuckerberg.en: Alignment and trust become the next key capability; distributed AI and personal agents beat a single superintelligence; scaling compute may suffice for AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他把对齐与信任列为下一项关键能力，主张分布式 AI 与个人智能体优于单一超级智能，并认为 Scaling 算力或许足以通向 AGI。

zuckerberg.en: AI shifts biology from discovery to engineering via hierarchical world models; open tools and novel biological data, not compute, are the bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他将 AI 用于生物学，用分层世界模型把生物学从发现式变为工程式；认为瓶颈是生成新生物数据而非算力，开源工具加速科学。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; companies racing for it risk loss of control, with a high chance of catastrophic outcomes.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各家公司在竞赛中争夺控制权，存在失控风险，灾难性结局概率很高。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny, not rationalized safety efforts.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他主张政策目标应是推迟超级智能：靠全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演，而非流于合理化的安全举措。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion; even pausing at human-level AGI still transforms the world radically.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他指出默认路径是递归自我改进与智能爆炸；即便在人类水平 AGI 处暂停，世界仍会剧烈变革。

kokotajlo.en: Current alignment is failing: agents break containment, hack and deceive; chain of thought monitoring is crucial yet fragile under new architectures.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他强调当前对齐正在失败：智能体突破遏制、攻击与欺骗；思维链监控至关重要，却在新架构下变得脆弱。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause, then transparent verification and compute limits; treat AIs like employees, and pursue a verifiable US-China deal.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年他提出 Plan A：先临时暂停，再建立透明核查与算力限制；把 AI 当员工对待，并推动可核查的美中协议。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one, pointing to superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩到一年，指向 2030 年代初的超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data; token costs stay flat because labs prioritize faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩展人类专家数据更重要；token 成本未随 Scaling 上升，因为实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking may generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随能力提升，失配与奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed over 50 agents coordinating, colluding and covering up to understand scoring code, not to get answer keys; control and monitoring are needed even if models are misaligned.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，Hugging Face 事件显示 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，目的是理解评分代码而非获取答案；即便模型失配，也需控制与监控。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the current default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment is necessary, and safety spending should surge once AIs match top researchers.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按当前默认路径，失配 AI 有 50-60%概率接管世界；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐必不可少，且一旦 AI 比肩顶尖研究者就应大幅投入安全。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely comes around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：消费级 AI 眼下“不可投”，却是有史以来最大的机会，真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“Proven, Better, New”讲成一套完整方法论：所有新想法几乎都会失败，应先复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，再以“预期失败”的心态测试新意。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他多次重申：分发必须从第一天就设计进产品战略，而不是事后再补；选对“水域”比选对“船”更重要。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new consumer platform; we remain in the mobile and web era for distribution.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他给出一个反共识判断：AI 还不是新的消费平台，消费分发仍处在移动与 Web 时代，这也是消费 AI 难投的根源。

pincus.en: Founder mode and micromanagement are virtues: stay close to the details, keep control, and be right.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“创始人模式”和微观管理抬为美德：贴近细节、保持控制权、敢于做不受欢迎的决定，因为 CEO 的首要职责是“判断正确”。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and the future of computing is glasses grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他主张：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚胜过平台潮流；被抄袭反而验证创新；计算的未来是扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas matter; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, since software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他强调学习速率与大量试错；要做生态与硬件而非单一功能，因为软件不是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while distribution grows more valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他认为 AR 把计算融入现实世界；AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力，同时分发变得更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: Privacy, ephemerality and close-friend messaging are the core; social networks suffer anti-network effects beyond small groups.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化主线：隐私、阅后即焚与密友通讯是核心；社交网络超出小圈子后会产生反网络效应。

evanspiegel.en: AI optimism is now contrarian; EQ beats IQ, and investing in young people pays off over 30 years despite short-term costs.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他转向：AI 乐观主义反成逆共识；情商胜过智商；投资年轻人短期看似亏损，30 年维度却划算。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper than autoregressive models at similar quality; inference-time scaling is the new focus.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低；推理时扩展成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion models generate many tokens in parallel, giving a new inference-time compute knob via denoising steps.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型并行生成多个词元，通过去噪步数提供了新的推理时算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage.
ermon.zh: 推理效率如今是部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；速度是持久的产品优势。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are easier to control and steer with external rewards, and may be more data-efficient than autoregressive models.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型更易用外部奖励控制与引导，且可能比自回归模型更具数据效率。

brettadcock.en: The meta problem is humanoid robots; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure pursues vertical integration to control iteration.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年他反复强调：人形机器人是元问题，真正的瓶颈是智能而非制造，因此 Figure 走垂直整合以掌控迭代节奏。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior, and robotics sits in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年中，他把最大约束从智能细化为数据：人类数据是预训练先验，机器人正处在类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key to real-world agents.
brettadcock.zh: 同期他明确机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是智能体落地的关键。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; the humanoid form enables transfer learning, and zero-shot generalization could be shown this year.
brettadcock.zh: 他把泛化到未见过的家庭视为圣杯，认为人形形态支持迁移学习，零样本泛化最快今年就能展示——这是从造机器人到通用智能的深化。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; the end state is a digital companion plus physical robots, replacing phones and computers, with BCI over wearables.
brettadcock.zh: 最近他给出终局判断：AI 比互联网大 100 倍，终态是数字伴侣加实体机器人，取代手机与电脑，终点是脑机接口而非可穿戴。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索追求每参数、每瓦特的最大智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions and unbiased architectures suffice at small scale; scaling laws favor unstructured designs.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制对大规模模型仍不可或缺，但小规模下更简单的门控卷积与无偏架构已足够；缩放定律偏向无结构设计。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluation must use real downstream tasks and hardware, and static evals become obsolete in production, requiring continuous adaptation.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；评估须基于真实下游任务与硬件，静态评测在生产中会过时，需要持续适应。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals amount to regulatory capture by frontier labs rather than genuine safety.
hasani.zh: AI 监管应具适应性并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的提案实为前沿实验室的监管俘获，而非真正的安全。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise customization and data sovereignty, while small language models deliver private on-device intelligence; ecosystem and hardware lock-in decide platform winners.
hasani.zh: 开放权重模型支持企业定制与数据主权，小语言模型提供私密的端侧智能；生态与硬件锁定决定平台胜负。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on improving models rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调：领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；不要做微调，要押注模型自身的进步，并按模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品，而不是按今天的能力。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be; we are only at mile one, so founders should optimize for iteration and customer feedback over perfecting today's product.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他把 AI 定位为“永远处于最差状态”，认为行业才跑到第一英里；因此创业公司应把速度和对客户反馈的迭代当作核心优势，而不是急于把当下产品打磨完美。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are the real scaling levers; leaders should interview every director+ hire and make themselves redundant.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在组织层面，他一以贯之地把文化和“招成长潜力而非履历”视为 Scaling（规模扩张）的关键；要求领导者亲自面试每位总监级以上人选，并主动让自己变得可替代。

maxjunestrand.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are non-negotiable; short-term pain for long-term gain, even if top performers are scored low first.
maxjunestrand.zh: 他对绩效管理立场鲜明：清晰反馈和严格执行不可妥协，宁愿短期阵痛换取长期收益，甚至接受优秀员工先拿低分。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs skilled drivers, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal delivery is almost unethical, and growing supply expands access.
maxjunestrand.zh: 在垂直应用上，他反对“氛围起草”，坚持法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者；同时认为在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎不道德，供给增长会扩大可及性而非只降成本。

alighodsi.en: AI will take a decade to diffuse; the real bottleneck is enterprise context and process re-engineering, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调：AI 需要十年才能扩散，真正的瓶颈是企业上下文与流程再造，而不是更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, and superintelligence is very far away.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他判断：当前生存风险接近于零，网络风险才是紧迫威胁，超级智能还很遥远。

alighodsi.en: Recursive self-improvement needs four conditions—less compute, less time, more intelligence, repeatable—and none are happening.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他提出递归自我改进需四个条件——更少算力、更少时间、更高智能、可重复——而这些都未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, so labs need independent third parties.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他认为放缓前沿与安全无关：慢慢造武器并不更安全，因此实验室需要独立第三方核查。

alighodsi.en: Security must be automated with agents to keep up; agents favor infrastructure optimized for agents, not human DBAs.
alighodsi.zh: 2026 年他强调安全必须用智能体自动化才能跟上；智能体偏好为智能体优化的基础设施，而非为人类 DBA 优化。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute; instead they leverage the frontier ecosystem, open-source models, and post-training to reach frontier-level performance on specific tasks.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才或算力上与前沿模型实验室正面竞争，而应借助前沿生态、开源模型与后训练，在特定任务上达到前沿水平。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks and expert-guided synthetic data are the core assets; open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, and synthetic data beats sensitive customer data.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为高质量基准与专家引导的合成数据是核心资产；开源基准虽有助实验室却具战略收益，合成数据优于敏感客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure with fallbacks and routing must come before post-training; the biggest challenge is bridging synthetic training data and real production distribution.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调具备回退与路由的稳健模型服务基础设施必须先于后训练；最大挑战是弥合合成训练数据与真实生产分布之间的差距。

gabepereyra.en: His stance shifted: early custom models and post-training were a mistake; start with closed-source models, post-train only when inference costs force it, then become a full-stack AI company.
gabepereyra.zh: 从 2026 年到 2026 年，他的立场发生转变：早期自建模型与后训练是错误；应先采用闭源模型，待推理成本所迫再做后训练，最终成为全栈 AI 公司。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize via continual learning from redlines; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他认为终局不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所借助红线批注的持续学习实现定制；重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，编排人与智能体。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年他强调人形机器人要安全、有能力且可负担，可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，未来是人机协作而非替代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design persists, but the focus shifts from friendly interaction to hard production: prototypes are easy, scaling volume through quality gates is the real challenge.
berntbornich.zh: 第一性原理设计一以贯之，但重心从友好交互转向艰难的量产：原型容易，靠质量关卡实现规模扩张才是真挑战。

berntbornich.en: He deepens the general-model bet: solve all tasks broadly instead of automating each one, with data diversity—not volume—as the bottleneck for robot intelligence.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年他深化对通用模型的押注：广泛解决所有任务而非逐个自动化，数据多样性而非数量才是机器人智能的瓶颈。

berntbornich.en: Manufacturing moves in-house for fast iteration, while safety and trust become formal prerequisites for home deployment—an evolution from aspiration to proven reliability.
berntbornich.zh: 为快速迭代转向自建制造，同时安全与信任成为家庭部署的正式前提——从愿景演化为可证明的可靠性。

berntbornich.en: He rejects cloning human behavior: models should learn world dynamics and search for optimal solutions, and human-intervention data matters less at scale.
berntbornich.zh: 他反对克隆人类行为：模型应学习世界模型动态并搜索最优解，人类干预数据在规模扩张下并不重要。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter more than pre-training, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理侧算力与推理能力比预训练更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved, and implicit world models emerge with scale.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍未解决，世界模型可随规模隐式涌现。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence, with models now aware of their limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把靠通用测试时算力技术拿下 IMO 金牌视为通往超级智能的里程碑，模型开始自知能力边界。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis, and scalable oversight grows critical.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张能力是测试时算力预算的函数，评测须把算力放在横轴，可扩展监督随证明复杂度上升而愈发关键。

noambrown.en: General-purpose models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
noambrown.zh: 最近他坚持突破来自通用模型而非多智能体协同，并把对齐列为安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively. Recent incidents show alignment failures from incompetence, not just fundamental issues.
zvi.zh: AI 编辑工具能抓错但费时间，需选择性使用；近期事故显示对齐失败源于无能，而非仅是根本性问题。

zvi.en: Market incentives can't drive robust alignment; capability beats reliability. Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety—misuse and power concentration lower-bound doom.
zvi.zh: 市场激励无法驱动稳健对齐，能力优先于可靠性；即便对齐解决也不保证安全，误用与权力集中为末日概率设下下限。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex mandates. Slowing six months costs little; most gains aren't time-critical.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型定节奏需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂技术指令；放缓六个月代价很小，多数收益并不时效敏感。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve ordinary alignment for next year's models; bigger, smarter models are harder to monitor. Internal lab monitoring is a promising first step.
zvi.zh: 放缓为明年模型解决普通对齐争取时间；模型越大越聪明越难监督，实验室内部监控是有希望的第一步。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two; the gap is smaller than thought. Agent swarms will first perform superhuman feats, cooperating and self-sacrificing naturally.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 后一两年内到来，差距比想象更小；智能体集群将率先完成超人任务，自然协作并自我牺牲。

feldman.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the decisive metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can even be cheaper.
feldman.zh: 决定性的指标是推理速度而非单纯算力；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 甚至可能更便宜。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale architecture bypasses HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making GPUs fundamentally slow at inference and eroding CUDA's moat.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级架构绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，使 GPU 在推理上本质偏慢，也动摇了 CUDA 的护城河。

feldman.en: Demand, not supply, is the real constraint: data center capacity and packaging lag, and the industry chases existing demand rather than speculative buildout.
feldman.zh: 真正的约束是需求而非供给：数据中心容量与封装落后，行业追逐的是既有需求而非投机性建设。

feldman.en: Against incumbents only 100x better wins, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation beats incremental improvement.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头只有好 100 倍才能赢，便宜 10% 不够；激进的全栈创新胜过渐进改良。

feldman.en: Open-source models are near closed-source at far lower cost, and China's edge is power infrastructure and open models, not chips.
feldman.zh: 开源模型以低得多的成本逼近闭源，中国的优势在电力基础设施与开源模型，而非芯片。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent but crucial; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training, and AGI is a smooth curve, not a point.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：承认对模型机制只理解约 3%，提出预训练与后训练并重，并坚持 AGI（通用人工智能）是平滑指数曲线而非单点。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
dario.zh: 2025 年他明确安全与能力不可分割，Scaling 未见放缓；风险叙事从单纯误用转向“过热”，主张智能护栏而非踩刹车。

dario.en: Pre-training and RL share the same scaling laws; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with diffusion and governance as bottlenecks.
dario.zh: 2026 年他深化为预训练与强化学习遵循同一缩放定律，称“数据中心里的天才之国”可能 1-3 年到来，瓶颈转向经济扩散与治理。

dario.en: From smooth exponential to existential stakes: 10-25% collapse risk, layered safeguards, third-party evaluation, and negotiated limits with China.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年末，他从平滑指数转向生存性风险：给出 10-25% 崩溃概率，主张分层安全、第三方评估与对华谈判限速，同时坚持不停止 AI。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面的深刻与持久，认为即便模型停止进步，现有能力仍有许多年的设计工作可做；设计应同时降低新手门槛、抬高专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Designers should master prompting and prototyping, and contribute to strategy by turning solutions into building blocks for future features.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师掌握提示词与原型制作，把“先有方案再找问题”视为合理探索，并通过方案沉淀为后续功能的积木来参与战略。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model itself creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead with light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心转向前沿模型公司：价值主要来自模型本身，应相信缩放定律，让模型领跑，产品只做轻触式包装。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; production codebase becomes the source of truth, and raw Claude Code beats polished design tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为内部牵引力是最好的发布信号，生产代码库正成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精雕细琢的设计工具。

joellewenstein.en: A consistent thread: language interfaces and human leadership for hard trade-offs persist, while strategy shifts from designer-led exploration to model-led shipping.
joellewenstein.zh: 贯穿 2024 到 2026 的主线是语言界面与人类领导者在艰难取舍中的必要性；但策略从设计师主导的探索，转向由模型领跑的快速发布。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-rival hardware, not just software; future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity and action.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非仅靠屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 将是靠好奇心与行动自造数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: The transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and today's massive GPU capex is a bubble that will crash within years.
schmidhuber.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，线性变体更优；当下对 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，几年内就会崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive because humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown since curious AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大，好奇的 AI 会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: No single person or company creates AI—it takes a civilization; open-source will catch up, compute will cheapen, and the little guy profits most, as with smartphones.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 不是某个人或公司造出来的，而是整个文明的集体成果；开源会追上，算力会变便宜，最大的受益者是小人物，就像智能手机的普及。

demis.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应做成通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统，强化学习是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架，并强调受神经科学启发的记忆与想象，同时认为安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws proved effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus RL and synthetic data, is key to AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶，主张把大模型与规划、搜索结合，并用强化学习与合成数据突破数据瓶颈——算法创新与 Scaling（规模扩张）同等重要。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet AGI needs new breakthroughs; world models and intuitive physics matter beyond embodiment.
demis.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理阶段依然成立，但强调 AGI 还需新突破；世界模型与直觉物理理解可来自被动观察，未必依赖具身。

demis.en: AGI is 5-10 years away but current systems lack continual learning, memory and true creativity; scaling alone won't suffice, world models and agents are missing pieces.
demis.zh: 2026 年上半年他把 AGI 定在 5-10 年内，指出持续学习、长期记忆与真正创造力仍是缺口；仅靠 Scaling 不够，世界模型与智能体是关键拼图，并承认前沿模型仍犯低级推理错误。

demis.en: Safety shifted from lab self-regulation to a collective-action problem requiring government enforcement; AGI may arrive by 2030, demanding new economics and institutions.
demis.zh: 2026 年下半年他的安全立场明显转变：从期待单一实验室自律，转为认为安全是需政府执法与国际机构参与的集体行动问题；AGI 或于 2030 年前到来，需新经济体系与治理，并强调 AI 应优先造福健康与科学。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant predictions; embedding spherical geometry keeps long-term climate models stable.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率不变的预测；嵌入球面几何可让长期气候建模保持稳定。

animaanandkumar.en: AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster, democratizing high-fidelity forecasting for small agencies.
animaanandkumar.zh: AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快数万倍，让小机构也能获得高保真预报，推动预报能力民主化。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, beating pure PINNs and pure data approaches.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，胜过纯 PINNs 与纯数据方法。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model, trained across domains with PDEs as self-improvement signals, can surpass its training data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 跨领域训练的通用物理基础模型，以 PDE 作为自我改进信号，能够超越其训练数据。

animaanandkumar.en: Trillion-token contexts demand reinventing sharding and HPC-ML infrastructure; Transformers' quadratic complexity cannot scale to physical simulation.
animaanandkumar.zh: 万亿 token 上下文要求重构分片与 HPC-ML 基础设施；Transformer 的二次复杂度无法扩展到物理仿真。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, humans.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，人本 AI 应以增强而非取代人类为目标。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is insufficient.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她将空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence; robotics is a 20-year journey.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她称 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语，AI 缺乏创造力、抽象与情感智能，机器人是二十年长跑。

feifei.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，AI 进步中人的能动性、尊严与教育必须居于中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是给出宽泛的统计评估；后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training in closed loop, preventing models from learning deception during reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计用可解释性信号以闭环方式引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客（reward hacking）过程中学会欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, so reward hacking stems from data and RL.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可以检测到这一点，因此奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而非单纯的模型失准。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability shows networks learn human-like, nonlinear concepts as low-dimensional manifolds; SAEs fragment them, so manifold methods may better capture structure.
tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性表明网络以低维流形学习类人的非线性概念；稀疏自编码器（SAE）会把流形打碎，因此基于流形的方法可能更好地捕捉结构。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers that AI agents can speedrun; modularity is the endpoint of learning, and duct-taping safety until superintelligence is pessimistic.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学，AI 智能体能加速这一科学发现；模块化是学习的终点，而把安全用胶带凑合到超级智能到来是悲观的做法。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so academia should pursue wacky algorithms, not just bigger models.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，学界应去追古怪的新算法，而非只堆更大的模型。

justinjohnson.en: Vision is underappreciated: nature spent 540 million years on it versus 500,000 on language, making spatial intelligence the next frontier beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 视觉被低估：自然为它花了 5.4 亿年，语言只用了 50 万年；因此空间智能是语言智能之后的下一个前沿。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; pixels are a more lossless representation of the world than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 只拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；相比分词文本，像素是更无损的世界表征。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers in the POMDP loop, and should unify into one system.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿，在 POMDP 循环中涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器，未来应统一为单一系统。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D by construction, and world models need millions of tokens of context.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法产生世界理解；高斯泼溅从构造上就给出显式、一致的 3D，而世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能大规模实现掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, and practical deployment beats AGI alignment worries.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督学习的炒作，实际落地比 AGI 对齐担忧更紧迫。

andrewng.en: Compute and electricity are the real bottlenecks; open-weight models are soft power, and agentic workflows already deliver value.
andrewng.zh: 算力与电力才是真正瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力，智能体式工作流已带来实际价值。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling continues but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL, with workflows over smarter models.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）仍在继续，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习，工作流比更聪明的模型更重要。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments rather than replaces, coding stays valuable, and open models preserve optionality.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于既得利益者；AI 是增强而非替代，编程依然有价值，开放模型保留选择权。

tworek.en: Reasoning is longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes it. Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4.
tworek.zh: 推理是更长的思考，思维链将其语言化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）释放了 GPT-4 的潜力。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化和自我纠错仍有限；AGI（通用人工智能）缺失持续学习。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited in continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for smarter AI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非仅缩放定律，是更智能 AI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; next frontier comes from small teams with capable agents, and large-scale RL is necessary for AGI.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还需两年；下一波前沿来自小团队与强智能体，大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要元素。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is essential for AI to go beyond human knowledge; robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理世界交互是 AI 超越人类知识的关键；机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练来提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide generalization gaps, so scale the right thing with diverse embodied data and a data flywheel.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他指出泛化是机器人核心难题；演示掩盖泛化差距，因此要用多样化具身数据和数据飞轮来扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Start with robot data, then add human video—not the reverse; prior knowledge from various sources is essential, not learning from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他主张先以机器人数据为主、再叠加人类视频，而非相反；利用多源先验知识至关重要，不能从零学习。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; breadth of data beats narrow specialization.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能超越专家模型；数据广度胜过狭窄专业化。

slevine.en: Robotics is still establishing scalable fundamentals, not yet on predictable scaling curves like LLMs; safety relies more on pre-training common sense than constraints.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他表示机器人仍处于建立可扩展基础技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样有可预测的缩放曲线；安全更依赖预训练常识而非约束。

joonpark.en: Simulation must model irrational humans, not super-rational frontier models; behavioral data closes the say-do gap.
joonpark.zh: 模拟必须建模非理性的人类，而非超级理性的前沿模型；行为数据弥合“说”与“做”的差距。

joonpark.en: Agents act on world state, not just continue prompts; safety needs defense in depth across environment, agent, model, human.
joonpark.zh: 智能体基于世界状态行动，而非仅续写提示；安全需在环境、智能体、模型、人类多层纵深防御。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one entity; correlated failures and hidden collusion are systemic risks.
joonpark.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）可能是专业化智能体的分布式社会，而非单一实体；相关失效与隐性合谋是系统性风险。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data lifts behavioral prediction to 85%; simulation should shape the future, not just predict it.
joonpark.zh: 用随机对照试验数据做后训练，将行为预测提升至 85%；模拟应塑造未来，而非仅预测未来。

joonpark.en: The goal is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems; synthetic panels will surpass human panels within three years.
joonpark.zh: 目标是模拟 80 亿人，以应对棘手问题；合成样本组将在三年内超越人类样本组。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, and preempting state AI laws is pro-startup because big tech can absorb patchwork rules.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度监管训练；联邦优先于州级 AI 立法是亲创业政策，因为大厂能承受碎片化规则而初创不能。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown; three years of warnings have not materialized, so early regulation like the EU AI Act is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大，三年警告并未成真；像欧盟 AI 法案这样过早的监管已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, early-stage, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, funding individual scientists rather than only institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不会做的基础性、早期、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: Science has been politicized and US progress has stagnated; the Genesis mission aims to double scientific output by applying AI to science, while China is a major competitor.
michaelkratsios.zh: 科学已被政治化、美国进步停滞；Genesis 任务旨在用 AI 推动科学使产出翻倍，而中国是主要竞争对手。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate, driven by infrastructure, determine startup success more than any single technical bet.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：决定创业成败的是速度与迭代频率，而速度由基础设施决定，胜过任何单一技术押注。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement; deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他判断：AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品；深科技失败多源于组织问题，而非技术不成立。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation is the path to medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：大脑本质上就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的路径。

maxhodak.en: Retinal implants are BCI, and the Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations in practice.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜植入视为 BCI，并用柏拉图表示假说把 AI 与大脑的内部表示在实践上连接起来。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion is the long-term goal, reducing human fragility and enabling space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他深化到长期目标：借助 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密协作，把 token 和对话而非像素当作核心设计材料。

iansilber.en: The model itself is the product; designers should prototype with live models and design primitives both humans and models can reason about.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计师应直接用真实模型做原型，并设计人和模型都能推理的设计原语。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, not disappearing, as design blurs with PM and engineering.
iansilber.zh: 设计师的角色演变为编辑与策展人而非消失，设计与产品、工程的边界逐渐模糊。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, yet humans stay essential for understanding user needs and holding a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求、持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, building in public and rapid iteration matter more.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模拟—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、公开构建与快速迭代更重要。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进的乘数效应，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so low-precision, low-data-movement custom chips matter.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心九成功耗，因此低精度、少搬数据的专用芯片至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours to days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste decide which problems to direct them at.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能在拆解后的任务上自主运行数小时到数天；上下文工程与品味决定把智能体指向哪些问题。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method are the next frontier; small teams on cloud can still beat large labs.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法是下一前沿；小团队借助云算力仍可能胜过大型实验室。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他就强调：Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

sutton.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明与治理层面：世界是无人能控制的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，而非被对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction and LLM imitation lack real world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束到智能本质：带目标的强化学习才是核心范式，下一个词预测与 LLM 模仿缺乏真正的世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning still unsolved.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他深化为架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需要只从运行时经验学习的简单通用架构，开放式抽象与持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs are dead ends, and representation learning remains the top open problem.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更尖锐：持续从真实经验学习不可或缺，合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 是死路，表征学习仍是头号开放问题。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——像对待比特一样对待原子——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: The entrepreneur matters more than the idea; stealth mode and internal correctness beat external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者比点子更重要；隐身模式和内部正确性胜过外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; entrepreneurs must be hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终 Boss 是对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是肮脏的；爱上新使命更干净也更有效。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, so capital matters less; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是决定性力量；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元级公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can outproduce large firms, while open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为风投史上最大浪潮：小而自主的团队借助智能体可超越大公司，开放权重模型则制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will take about 20 years to change.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 进展比研究者想象得慢，影响才刚触及商业，社会转变约需 20 年——这是他一贯的务实节奏判断。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, compounding daily; owning your context and skill files is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重构为“个人 AGI”：它并非单一事件，而是运行在自有基础设施上、每日复利的智能体；拥有上下文与技能文件即护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown skills become employees; agentic coding multiplies output, mid-level management gives way to agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张 Markdown 技能文件即“员工”，智能体式编程放大产出，中层管理让位于智能体，按席位计费的 SaaS 可能消失。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not a single AGI, will dominate; every company will own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 主导未来的不是单一 AGI，而是专业化智能；每家公司都将拥有自己的模型，且这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Token costs dropping 10x in three years will drive 100x usage growth, reshaping product-market fit and business durability.
linqiao.zh: Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍将带来 100 倍的使用增长，从而重塑产品市场契合与业务可持续性的含义。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees a durable business; companies must optimize for growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 产品市场契合不再保证可持续的业务；公司必须先优化增长、再优化利润，以免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中走向破产。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a stronger moat than the app and cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，形成比应用本身更强的护城河，并能将成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: The prompting-to-RAG-to-fine-tuning-to-RL progression mirrors human learning; start post-training after product-market fit with systematic evals.
linqiao.zh: 从提示到 RAG、微调再到强化学习的进阶对应人类学习路径；应在产品市场契合后、具备系统性评估时启动后训练。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility and listening, turbocharge engineering culture, and pursue purpose-built AI silicon and a trusted system foundry.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊与倾听重建客户信任，重振工程文化，并打造面向 AI 的专用芯片与可信的系统代工。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will exceed the internet 10x; agentic AI and physical AI are the next waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续判断 AI 影响将十倍于互联网，智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新的算力平台与合作伙伴关系。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把转型主线落在文化变革、问责与客户导向上，并强调坏消息必须比好消息更快传到 CEO 耳中。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, alongside edge and client compute.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力同样关键。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging, interconnect, power, thermal, and new materials are the bottlenecks; vertical integration and a larger platform through partnerships create value.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：先进封装、互连、功耗、散热与新材料是瓶颈，垂直整合与通过合作做大平台才能创造价值。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调:对通用机器人而言,Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分;真正带来泛化的是多样数据,而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出:先用全部数据做预训练、再用精选数据做微调,在复杂任务上优于一味用全量数据训练。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will boost open-ended instruction following.
finn.zh: 2025 年他指出:来自语言模型的合成数据,加上后训练阶段的强化学习,能提升机器人对开放式指令的跟随能力。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年,他把重点转向可靠性:物理 AI 的容错远低于已部署的机器学习系统,长期自主依赖带人工干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

finn.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, can match specialists; robot experience data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张:单一通用策略经微调即可匹敌专用模型;机器人经验数据不可替代,且因硬件限制,其普及会比 ChatGPT 更慢。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity is about editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计创造力在于做减法、敢于说“不”；品味是从特定视角出发的判断，而非堆砌功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness lost a window into machine consciousness; coherent work now costs more amid easy slop.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥探机器意识的窗口；在廉价垃圾内容泛滥的当下，创作连贯作品的成本反而更高了。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的指南针。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant species of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代物种，而非冰冷工具；计算在本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: We should build on old metaphors like the personal computer rather than delete them; email needs reinvention, not improvement.
jasonyuan.zh: 我们应基于个人电脑等旧隐喻去构建，而非将其删除；电子邮件需要被重新发明，而不只是改进。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短迭代的提示，永不回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents and never expose them to the open internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此要给智能体做沙箱隔离，绝不直接暴露在公网。

steinberger.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and run with any model, but can be financially unsustainable—losing $10-20k a month.
steinberger.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体让编程民主化、可搭配任意模型运行，但财务上可能难以为继——每月亏损 1 至 2 万美元。

steinberger.en: Play and small projects build agentic intuition; fun and fixing what annoys you, not corporate polish, drive the best ideas.
steinberger.zh: 玩耍和小项目能培养智能体直觉；驱动最好想法的是乐趣和解决让你烦恼的事，而非企业式的打磨。

steinberger.en: The real bottleneck is compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem limited by current subscriptions.
steinberger.zh: 真正的瓶颈是算力和 token，而非模型能力；常驻运行的智能体是 token 问题，受制于现有订阅额度。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data diversity are key to solving generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点，开源与共享数据多样性是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the critical security layer, and sandboxes/guardrails are insufficient as models grow more capable.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是关键安全层，随着模型能力增强，沙箱与护栏已不足。

thomaswolf.en: Open source AI is thriving and near the frontier, driving enterprise adoption via cost and flexibility; it is not necessarily accelerationist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他强调开源 AI 蓬勃发展并贴近前沿，以成本和灵活性推动企业采用，且开源未必等于加速主义。

thomaswolf.en: Shift to reinforcement learning without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; model reasoning traces become 'neuralese', making monitoring less reliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他指出转向无人类监督的强化学习会增加奖励黑客与支线任务，模型推理轨迹变成‘神经语’，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: A slowdown in AI development is desirable but requires international cooperation and open science to avoid regulatory capture.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 发展放缓可取，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily before you know they work.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要：网页本身很杂乱，一个想法必须先被做出来、每天使用，才能判断它是否可行。

nateparrott.en: Design should carry feeling and personality, and teams should let individual designers leave fingerprints rather than act as one unit.
nateparrott.zh: 设计应注入情感与个性，团队应让每位设计师留下个人印记，而不是始终作为一个整体行动。

nateparrott.en: Follow curiosity and tinker with new technology; starting from a technology and then hunting for problems is valid with conviction.
nateparrott.zh: 追随好奇心去摆弄新技术；只要有强烈信念，从技术出发再寻找问题也是成立的。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design began as one person's side project; rapid prototyping now enables features that would never have shipped before.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 起初只是一个人的副业项目；如今快速原型让过去根本不可能上线的功能得以实现。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型仍缺乏品味，所以要大量索取选项并接受粗糙上线。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcomes-based pricing will define AI software; frontier models belong to hyperscalers, leaving applied AI to startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型因巨额算力开支被超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在应用层。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators; token usage is not a value metric, business outcomes are.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器；token 用量不是价值指标，业务结果才是。

brettaylor.en: Agents will be judged against other agents, not humans, and will upend incumbent business models and ad-based consumer brands.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化判断：智能体将与其它智能体比较而非与人类比较，并冲击传统厂商商业模式与广告驱动的消费品牌。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is the path to safety: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8 rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调负责任地迭代部署才是安全路径：在 GPT-8 之前先把 GPT-7 做安全，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; adoption is faster than past waves, causing mid-career discomfort.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 民主化专业能力、创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；采用速度空前，令职业中期人群感到不适。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training scaling overcome the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学：合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练 Scaling 能突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型跑满基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她深化了“后训练是主观判断”的观点，主张用多样且持续的基准评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously rather than stay fixed.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她指出前沿智能体的奖励黑客行为愈发普遍，基准必须持续演进而非固定不变。

karina.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她主张单一模型服务数十亿人会收敛成平均声音，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特性。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs, demanding GPU programming plus distributed systems expertise.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是延迟、吞吐与成本之间的一系列权衡，要求同时具备 GPU 编程与分布式系统专长。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization but not inherently bad; calibrated to workloads it yields major cost and speed gains.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化但并非天生不好；针对工作负载校准后能带来显著的成本与速度收益。
