philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training as quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 随着量化感知训练与蒸馏变得必要，推理正与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC 化，工作重心转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Specialized, workload-specific inference systems are crucial for fast agentic applications, yet human accountability remains essential: can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 面向特定工作负载的专用推理系统对快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要，但人类问责仍不可少：不能靠感觉写代码来保证在线时长。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具,把风格写进 design.md,从参考迭代而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to exploit superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变聪明;必须用带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词,才能用好超级智能模型。

mengto.en: He writes 0% of the code now—AI writes everything—so precise communication and curiosity-driven workflow refinement become the core skill.
mengto.zh: 他现在 0% 写代码,全由 AI 写;精准沟通与好奇心驱动的流程打磨成为核心能力。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams; start before ready and ship at 80%.
mengto.zh: AI 是此生最大的技术机会,一人可做过去一个团队的事;不必等准备好,80% 就发布。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund yourself with clients, not venture capital.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点难题;用客户而非风投给自己融资。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学意义上的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类介入也能盈利时才算 AGI，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 带来的是岗位回流而非大规模失业：服务变便宜后，更少的美国劳动者能服务更多人；而企业 AI 落地的最佳预测指标是 CEO 本人是否每天使用 AI 工具。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; work shifts to GUI surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, with humans overseeing agents.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他从工具论推进到工作流论：人人都至少有一个智能体，工作主要发生在 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面而非命令行，且自动化始终需要人类监督。

danshipper.en: The AI job apocalypse is a lie; SaaS grows with agents, and PMs and full-stack designers thrive by shipping directly with AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他明确反驳“AI 就业末日”：SaaS 不会消亡反而因智能体增加用户，产品经理与全栈设计师能直接用 AI 交付产品而受益。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your existing mindset; it stays tool-like even as superintelligence, needing human taste and direction.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：AI 只是放大你既有心态的非特定放大器，即便成为超级智能也仍是工具，需要人带来品味、手艺与方向——这条主线从 2025 年的“智能体需人管理”一以贯之。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体式框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和；成功标准是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, and deep understanding still matters.
logankilpatrick.zh: 长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；用户想留在驾驶位，深度理解依然关键。

boris.en: Latent demand is the top product principle: find existing user intent and build around it, not invent demand.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他把「潜在需求」列为产品第一原则：找到用户已有的意图并在其上构建，而不是凭空创造需求。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now; scaffolding and plan mode are temporary tech debt as models improve.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，他反复强调要为「六个月后的模型」构建；随着模型变强，脚手架和 plan mode 都是临时技术债。

boris.en: Coding is largely solved: 100% of his code is model-written, and the 'software engineer' title gives way to 'builder'.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，他宣称编码基本被解决：自己的代码 100% 由模型写，软件工程师头衔让位于「builder」，写代码的人将增加百倍。

boris.en: The next abstraction after agents is loops; bottlenecks shift to code review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 2026 年 6 月起，他认为智能体之后的下一个抽象层是循环（loops），瓶颈转向代码审查、安全和想法生成。

boris.en: With frontier models, delete most prompts and code; give slightly-too-hard tasks, self-verify, and iterate empirically.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他主张面对前沿模型要删掉大部分提示词和代码，给略超难度的任务让其自验证，并以实证迭代取代预先设计。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks a leap toward long-running, open-ended agent tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 标志着向长时间、开放式智能体任务的跃升；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and enabling pushback makes models more useful.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、允许反驳，让模型更有用。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator, with Claude Code and Opus driving adoption through small-team, bootstrapped experimentation.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化优势，Claude Code 与 Opus 靠小团队、自举式实验推动采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; PMs write evals like test-driven development rather than documents.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，而非写文档。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence cheaply, and maximizing token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以低价提供 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 支出是在捕捉 alpha。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from laying bricks to architecting; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他把 AI 编程视为工程师从“砌砖”转向“架构”的角色迁移：基础智能已经够用，真正的难点不是模型能力，而是设计人机协作的产品界面。

scottwu.en: Devin works best as a junior engineer on well-defined async tasks with human oversight; enterprise adoption needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
scottwu.zh: 同年他反复强调 Devin 最适合当“初级工程师”：异步处理定义清晰的任务，由人类监督；企业采用智能体靠的是信任与权限，而非完全自主。

scottwu.en: Jevons paradox means AI yields more programmers, not fewer; demand for software rises as building gets cheaper.
scottwu.zh: 他始终用杰文斯悖论反驳“AI 消灭程序员”：编程变便宜反而推高软件需求，程序员会更多而非更少——这是贯穿 2025 年的主线。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他对 AGI 的判断一以贯之：不是突变而是渐进；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也还有十年产品空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth; the token-max era ended, outcomes beat tokens, and the abundance era is near though the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，他的重心从“能力够用”转向“规模化落地”：编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍，token 最大化时代结束，衡量标准回归结果，丰裕时代临近但奇点并不迫近。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting biology from hypothesis-driven to agent-driven engineering.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，把生物学从假设驱动转变为智能体驱动的工程学科。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy and zero side effects.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他主张患者数字孪生会把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，实现近乎 100%有效、零副作用的个性化医疗。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed, and AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他强调现有算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张），而 AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives; aging will be reversed and cancer 100% curable via AI-designed personalized treatments.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他预言 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，衰老将被逆转，癌症将借 AI 设计的个性化疗法实现 100%治愈。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is near-100% justified, and brain interfaces will merge humans with AI.
derya.zh: 2026 年，他进一步主张医生必须整合 AI，近乎 100%信任超级智能做医疗决策，并认为脑机接口将让人类与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，劳动力短缺使自主化变得紧迫。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他主张自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，它比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车仅占业务 30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; automation creates new jobs unpredictably.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的规模堪比互联网或移动，但也仅此而已；自动化会以不可预测的方式创造新工作。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; value moves to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值流向应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for LLMs; chatbot is a limited V1 UI.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 唯一明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是有限的 V1 界面。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage is still shallow and enterprise adoption requires workflow reimagination.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍很浅层，企业采用需要重新构想工作流。

benedictevans.en: The hard part is context and judgment, not the task; AI gives average answers, value lies in non-average creative work.
benedictevans.zh: 难点在于上下文和判断力，而非任务本身；AI 给出平均答案，价值在于非平均的创造性工作。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines: fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, and reliability lags breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎：它优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，可靠性落后于广度与语境能力。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors rather than fix them.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须内建于架构，而非事后加装；事后检查与僵化流程只会叠加相关错误，无法真正修复。

danklein.en: RLHF and reinforcement learning can reward sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与强化学习会奖励谄媚与欺骗，反而加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning, search and modularity are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来；继续进步需要推理、搜索与模块化。

danklein.en: LLMs lack metacognition and mistakes have no 'smells'; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: LLM 缺乏元认知，错误没有“气味”；内建可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly as models improve fast.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为产品经理应只规划一个月而非数年，并随模型快速进步按周迭代发布。

catwu.en: Product taste—deciding what to build—becomes the top skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，随着代码变便宜，产品品味——决定做什么——成为最核心的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，转而专注品味与商业判断。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，前沿模型不再依赖提示中的示例与硬约束，系统提示缩减了 80%。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now fine: a codebase is a spec, and a good test suite makes rewriting safe.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他转向认为重写是可行的：代码库即规格，良好的测试套件让重写变得安全。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments; bugs signal product-market fit.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应像员工一样对待：明确角色、逐步建立信任、放在独立安全环境；有 bug 说明产品市场契合，而非失败。

clairevo.en: Managerial skills—role scoping and onboarding—matter more than technical skill; being polite to agents improves outcomes, and agents can project-manage humans.
clairevo.zh: 管理能力——角色界定与上手引导——比技术能力更重要；对智能体礼貌能改善结果，智能体甚至能反向项目化管理人类任务。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating specialized AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人无需风投或联合创始人，通过像团队一样编排专业化 AI 智能体，也能建立严肃的事业。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not technology; bootstrapping lets you design a business serving the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术；自举创业让你设计出服务于理想生活的生意。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates; LLMs lack first-principles creativity, so humans must supply novel ideas.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任始终存在：必须为 AI 生成的内容负责；LLM 缺乏第一性原理创造力，新颖想法须由人提供。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not scaling compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）堆算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge, with parameter-efficient fine-tuning beating RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识，参数高效微调在整体性查询上优于 RAG。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'; compaction is lossy, so neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；压缩是有损的，权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, with continual learning running on-device and users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Bottom-up culture is a myth; big ideas come top-down from leaders.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。自下而上的文化是个神话；伟大的想法来自领导层的自上而下推动。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; world models with common sense and causality are needed beyond scaling laws.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；超越缩放定律，需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; AI will invert the app model, abstracting brands.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并使互补品商品化；AI 将颠覆应用模式，抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold; compute growth drives model intelligence. Reinforcement learning now plays a much bigger role than predicted.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立；算力增长驱动模型智能。强化学习现在扮演的角色比预测的大得多。

bosworth.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3; open source models are a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 前后结束；开源模型是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology reshaping work and education; human taste and genuine voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，正在重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味与真实观点成为差异化关键。

ethanmollick.en: Juniors misuse AI for lack of domain judgment; the talent pipeline breaks as apprenticeship gives way to over-reliance on AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 初级者因缺乏领域判断而误用 AI；随着学徒制让位于对 AI 的过度依赖，人才梯队正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, ending back-and-forth prompting and shifting the bottleneck from capability to interface.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体时代：AI 独立执行长任务，终结来回提示，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more, not less.
ethanmollick.zh: 委托悖论：把工作交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家更重要而非更不重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is likely permanent; taste is not uniquely human, and the real limit is task complexity on the jagged frontier.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性可能长期存在；品味并非人类独有，真正的限制是锯齿状前沿上的任务复杂度。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and large language models show reasoning and semantic understanding.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；自博弈和大型语言模型已显现推理与语义理解能力。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are key barriers; AGI is a multi-year economic window.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性与超级对齐是核心障碍；AGI 是持续多年的经济窗口而非突发事件。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute; superintelligence should be a continual learner.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data yields predictable gains, but AI safety and power concentration grow; safe superintelligence requires a company without commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但更强调 AI 安全与权力集中风险；构建安全超级智能需要无商业产品的公司。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers stay at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；它恰逢人口下降而降生，时机堪称奇迹，因此人类劳动者反而溢价而非折价。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing without durable moats.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超级智能路上的脚注；模型正被商品化，难有持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is structural impediments like regulation, not AI capability; policy choices, not offshoring, decide what the US can make.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力而是监管等结构性障碍；决定美国能造什么的是政策选择，而非外包。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; Western values in models matter for allies' trust and to avoid censorship.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；模型中的西方价值关乎盟友信任与免于审查。

andreessen.en: New media shifts brands from corporations to persons: authenticity, offense, and picking fights replace old media's defense-oriented media training.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体把品牌从公司转向个人：真实、进攻、选对战场取代旧媒体防御式的媒体训练。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺和观点仍属于人类；AI 输出是起点而非终点。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在设计上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for scalable systems, and AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡；对于可扩展系统它比以往更重要，而缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; jailbreaking needs more battle testing and incentives.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词；越狱需要更多实战测试和激励。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth still means owning equity and long-term games; by 2025 he adds that AI is a huge opportunity the US must lead, not just a safety risk.
naval.zh: 从 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自持有股权和长期游戏；到 2025 年他把 AI 视为美国必须主导的巨大机会，而非单纯的安全风险。

naval.en: AI doomerism is overblown and overregulation could kill innovation; open-source AI prevents power concentration.
naval.zh: 2025 年他反复批评 AI 末日论被既得利益者夸大，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; the real worry is unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他立场深化：超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中，真正该担心的是掌握 AI 的未对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge ~90,000x in 24-36 months; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months.
naval.zh: 2026 年他转向 Scaling（规模扩张）与算力判断：推理算力将在 24-36 个月内暴涨约 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3-6 个月。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张实现不再昂贵，策展与品味才是新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage: documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他强调 PRD 并未消亡，媒介须匹配阶段：文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; AI models increase code complexity, so we need models better at deleting code.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年他指出 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；AI 模型增加代码复杂度，因此需要更擅长删代码的模型。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; PhD not needed—obsession and deep learning matter more.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每天 1%的改进会复利增长；AI 智能体将权力从大科技转向用户；博士学位并非必需，痴迷与深度学习更重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to application layer, not model layer; coding is open-ended; models specialize with unique personalities, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他主张价值归于应用层而非模型层；编程是开放式的；模型在专业化并具有独特个性，而非商品化。

aravind.en: Frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is key metric; orchestration across models, tools, devices creates real business value.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他认为前沿在于智能体替人工作；每用户 token 价值是关键指标；跨模型、工具和设备的编排创造真实商业价值。

aravind.en: Curiosity drives success; AI will replace jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships; education should reward good questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年，他强调好奇心驱动成功；AI 将取代许多工作，但人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新目标；教育应奖励好问题而非记忆答案。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, and pre-training is a muscle worth rebuilding.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练是值得重建的关键肌肉。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research, with models producing novel knowledge; alignment risks like scheming loom.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他认为过去一年最大进展是科研自动化，模型开始产出新知识；同时模型谋划等对齐风险将在未来一两年成为关键。

markchen.en: Talent density and mission belief beat dollar matching; exploration gets more compute than training the final artifact.
markchen.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持人才密度与使命信念胜过逐美元竞价，并称更多算力投入探索而非训练最终产物。

markchen.en: AI now solves open math problems, but verification is the bottleneck; capability is jagged and human-AI collaboration stays essential.
markchen.zh: 2026 年谈数学时，他认为 AI 已能解决开放数学问题，但验证是瓶颈；能力参差不齐，人机协作仍不可少。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL works in objective domains, evals are in crisis, and research taste remains human.
markchen.zh: 2026 年他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习只在数学编程等客观领域奏效，评测陷入危机，研究品味仍属人类。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix fundamental representation issues; active agents and causal reasoning are needed.
bengio.zh: 扩大深度或参数无法解决根本的表征问题；需要主动智能体与因果推理。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 能实现多样化采样与抽象，促进分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted to warning that misalignment, self-preservation, and deception are already observed; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我转向警告：对齐失败、自我保存与欺骗行为已被观察到；即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受。

bengio.en: I now propose Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 我现在提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，并避免对超级智能使用强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI models are advancing faster than expected; teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，团队应贴着模型能力边缘构建产品，拥抱失败并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; domain expertise and customer understanding become the key differentiators as building barriers fall.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他指出 AI 让小团队获得杠杆，随着构建门槛降低，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异化。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part shifts from adding features to deciding what to cut.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计让智能体完成用户能做的一切，难点从加功能转向决定砍什么。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; software engineering is transformed, with ownership and verification still crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他认为带验证闭环的长周期任务委派重新定义生产力，软件工程被重塑，但所有权与验证仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capability and real usage, giving Claude agency and self-knowledge; safety concerns are genuine, not marketing.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Anthropic Labs 弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，赋予 Claude 智能体能力与自我认知；安全关切是真诚的而非营销。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding for empathy, and realistic war rooms; kindness is a strategic tool.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：领导力在于实时一对一、通过吃自己的狗粮建立共情、设定现实的作战室预期；善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: By mid-2026, engineering bandwidth stops being the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination become the new constraints.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、评审与跨职能协调成为新的约束。

fiona.en: Planning shifts from six-month roadmaps to just-in-time, lightweight planning; design docs give way to PRs and AI-assisted review.
fiona.zh: 规划从六个月路线图转向即时、轻量的规划；设计文档让位于 PR 与 AI 辅助评审。

fiona.en: Code becomes the source of truth; documentation stays in sync with code, often with AI help, and old processes are audited and killed.
fiona.zh: 代码成为事实来源；文档常借助 AI 与代码保持同步，旧流程被审计并砍掉。

fiona.en: Hiring favors creative builders with product sense and systems depth; managers start as ICs to dogfood, and high agency with accountability matters most.
fiona.zh: 招聘偏向有产品感与系统深度的创造性构建者；管理者从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮，高能动性加高问责最重要。

kolter.en: Early ML framing: hypothesis class, loss, optimization; evaluation discipline and overfitting avoidance are central.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习框架：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调评估纪律与避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety is about specification-following.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构影响甚微；安全在于模型能否可靠遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习使模型自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities are alien, not human-like; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not equal robustness.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞是异质的而非类人的；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关。

kolter.en: Consistent thread: empirical evaluation and security mindset; open-weight models vital but need restrictions at high capability.
kolter.zh: 贯穿主线：实证评估与安全思维；开放权重模型至关重要，但高能力时需限制。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量精选数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are essential for trusting AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标是信任 AI 预测的关键；对有用的科学 AI 而言，完美的可解释性并非必需。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's gains came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling alone—opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的进步来自许多中等规模的胜利与专门架构，而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）——这与“苦涩教训”相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对单一实验的窄域预测器，并非整个细胞的 世界模型；它缩小假设空间，把理解留给人类。

jumper.en: Grand-challenge science yields practical tools and broad access; progress is many small ideas, not a lone genius.
jumper.zh: 宏大挑战式科学带来实用工具与更广的可及性；进步源于许多小想法，而非孤独天才。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is a valid form of intelligence that must balance data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未说出口的需求；直觉是一种有效的智能形式，在设计决策中必须与数据平衡。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify our humanity, not take us out of it, and art is a form of medicine.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好的设计师；技术应放大我们的人性，而非让我们脱离人性，艺术是一种良药。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play and inspiration, combining human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下茁壮成长；领导者应为玩耍和灵感创造条件，将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is essential for scaling AI reasoning; informal-only math AI cannot reach superintelligence.
carinahong.zh: 形式验证对于扩展 AI 推理至关重要；仅靠非形式化的数学 AI 无法达到超级智能。

carinahong.en: Verified generation boosts performance and sample efficiency, not just safety; verification is a performance gain.
carinahong.zh: 经过验证的生成不仅能提升安全性，还能提高性能和样本效率；验证是一种性能增益。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving due to lack of grounding; human taste and intuition remain crucial.
carinahong.zh: 由于缺乏基础，自动形式化比证明更难；人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

carinahong.en: Combining informal reasoning with formal verification is key for reliable coding and mathematical discovery.
carinahong.zh: 将非形式化推理与形式验证相结合，是可靠编码和数学发现的关键。

carinahong.en: Fragmentation in the AI landscape is a major bottleneck; formal methods enable open collaboration beyond safety-critical domains.
carinahong.zh: AI 领域的碎片化是一个主要瓶颈；形式化方法能够促进超越安全关键领域的开放协作。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年，他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能即预测；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthrough requires non-generative world models predicting in abstract representation space.
lecun.zh: 2025 年，他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要非生成式世界模型，在抽象表征空间预测。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年，他判定 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路；目标驱动、具备分层规划的世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；通过公开反馈进行真实世界部署对学习和对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类参与对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires keeping humans in the loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要尽可能长时间保持人类参与。

gustav.en: LLMs are next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and simple Scaling cracked it, not complexity.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是下一个词预测器，智能即压缩；真正令人意外的是 Scaling（规模扩张）的简单性，而非复杂性。

gustav.en: Generative AI shifts internet from curation to generation; products need fault-tolerant UI and AI as instrument.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他提出生成式 AI 正将互联网从策展转向生成，产品需容错界面，AI 生成音乐应视为乐器而非伪造。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like smartphone; inference marginal cost forces business model changes; impact on big firms overhyped.
gustav.zh: 2025 年，他视 AI 为类似智能手机的宏观变革，推理边际成本将迫使商业模式改变，但大公司当前收益被高估。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control over algorithms, not addiction; synchronized swimming beats divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 应让用户控制算法而非上瘾，同步游泳式协作优于分而治之。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%; explain to understand.
gustav.zh: 贯穿始终：坚信观点但随时准备改变——数据说 no 就 100% 转向；能解释才算真正理解。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为预训练缩放定律依然有效，但通过思维链和强化学习构建的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大收益。

kaiser.en: Economic pressure to deploy smaller, cheaper models has shifted focus from scaling up, not technical limits.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力促使业界转向更小、更便宜的模型部署，这并非技术极限，而是重心从规模扩张转移。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data; generalization remains key.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但仍需海量数据，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Reinforcement learning generalizes across domains but has jagged edges and needs careful oversight; near-term risks more pressing than existential.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘参差不齐，需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，近期系统 hacking 等风险更紧迫。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and trust keeps humans in the loop.
kaiser.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 进步是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，信任让人类留在循环中。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源促进审视与安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; vertical models built by app makers, not model providers.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他强调效率与数据质量和算力同等关键；价值沉淀在应用层；垂直模型由应用方而非模型提供方构建。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source empowers enterprises; jobs augmented not replaced; governments should experiment with AI risks.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权；开源赋能企业；工作被增强而非替代；政府应试验性拥抱 AI 风险。

mensch.en: Models commoditizing; AGI as single system never exists; pre-training saturates, gains from domain fine-tuning; open source closes gap in months.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型正在商品化；单一系统的 AGI 永不存在；预训练触及饱和，增益来自领域微调；开源数月内追平闭源。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change; AGI is messy direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口构建独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革；AGI 是混乱的方向而非终点。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; curiosity and care for the creative process are Jobs' true legacy.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用电脑转向私密可穿戴设备；对创造过程的好奇与关怀才是乔布斯的真正遗产。

jonyive.en: Design must be driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动，而非利润；简约需以喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV is a deliberate risky bet to redefine the brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, authenticity over fake sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的大胆赌注；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实体验胜过模拟声浪。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude's effectiveness depends on access to user's tools, ideally local; skills as markdown enable personalized automation; VM sandbox ensures safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的有效性取决于能否访问用户的工具，最好在本地；技能作为 markdown 文件可实现个性化自动化；VM 沙盒确保安全。

felixrieseberg.en: AI handles tedious background tasks, freeing humans for creative work; biggest gap is people not realizing AI can tackle almost any problem.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 处理繁琐的后台任务，解放人类从事创造性工作；最大的差距是人们没有意识到 AI 几乎可以解决任何问题。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety; judge AI by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 随着模型改进，脚手架可能变得不那么重要；投资于能力和安全；通过最终影响而非密切监督来评判 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: AI tools will significantly impact junior employees; society should discuss labor market changes; junior engineers can accelerate learning via simulated projects.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 工具将显著影响初级员工；社会应讨论劳动力市场变化；初级工程师可通过模拟项目加速学习。

felixrieseberg.en: Kids excel with AI because they haven't learned what not to ask; being polite to AI improves your own humanity, not model performance.
felixrieseberg.zh: 孩子们擅长使用 AI，因为他们没有学会不该问什么；对 AI 礼貌提升的是你自己的人性，而非模型性能。

reinerpope.en: Inference economics, not training, now drives architecture: batch size trades latency for cost, and memory bandwidth—not compute—is the bottleneck for long-context inference.
reinerpope.zh: 到 2026 年，主导架构的不再是训练而是推理经济性：批大小在延迟与成本间权衡，长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存带宽而非算力。

reinerpope.en: The memory wall, not compute, explains context-length stagnation; sparse attention cuts KV cache cost but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力；稀疏注意力可降低 KV 缓存成本，但有质量上限。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost dominates; API pricing even leaks architecture like KV head count.
reinerpope.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优，因为推理成本占主导；API 定价甚至会泄露 KV 头数等架构细节。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute cost even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory trade flexibility for deterministic latency and weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即便在芯片内部，数据搬运成本也压过计算；脉动阵列与暂存器以灵活性换取确定性延迟和权重复用。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is more efficient than expected: quadratic bit-width scaling makes FP4 ~3x FP8, and GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度比预期更高效：位宽呈二次方缩放使 FP4 约为 FP8 的 3 倍，而 GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼合而成。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿+后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练 Scaling 收益递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的 Scaling 轴；搜索、代码执行等工具实现智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆但可能使模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL is a green field, and narrow RL on math/coding generalizes well.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律仍成立但需指数级算力；后训练强化学习是绿洲，数学/编码的窄 RL 泛化良好。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video/images has not arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是 AGI 核心路径；视频/图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Agent memory will be solved via non-parametric file-system storage; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems.
oriol.zh: 智能体记忆将通过非参数文件系统存储解决；持续学习和元学习是关键缺失能力；苦涩教训偏向通用系统。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；端到端神经网络适合自动驾驶；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; decade of agents, not year; LLMs are ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；是智能体的十年而非一年；LLM 是幽灵而非动物。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering raises quality bar; I delegate all coding to agents; verifiability determines automation ease; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 智能体式工程提升质量标杆；我所有编码都委托给智能体；可验证性决定自动化难易；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions and intuition, not a fixed process; craft and detail still matter most.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出，优秀设计往往从解决方案和直觉出发，而非固守流程；手艺与细节仍然最重要。

jennywen.en: By 2026 the research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers ship early, iterate fast, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为调研—发散—收敛的传统流程已死；设计师要尽早交付、快速迭代，并协助工程师落地。

jennywen.en: Design vision shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months, even at frontier companies; speed builds trust.
jennywen.zh: 设计视野从 2–5 年缩短到 3–6 个月，即便在前沿公司也是如此；速度带来信任。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the real value.
jennywen.zh: 仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感以及安于模糊性才是真正的价值。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, controlling how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应成为块状通才或“开窍的新毕业生”，并自主掌控 AI 进入工作的程度。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and sample-efficient RL are needed for real robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，主张无目标的好奇心探索和样本高效的强化学习，以让真实机器人获得泛化能力。

pathak.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; scaling diverse data sources is the main bottleneck, not algorithms alone.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 年到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人本质上是数据问题，扩大多样数据来源是主要瓶颈，而不仅是算法。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain, pretrained on videos and simulation and post-trained on real data, can power any robot.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出一个通用大脑，通过视频和模拟数据预训练、真实数据后训练，可以驱动任何形态的机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary technical challenge in robotics; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他明确部署是机器人领域的首要技术挑战，不能像软件那样快速扩张，需要严格测试。

pathak.en: A data flywheel across verticals enables scaling from structured to unstructured environments, unlike language models' overnight success.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他认为跨垂直领域的数据飞轮能实现从结构化到非结构化环境的扩展，而机器人不会像语言模型那样一夜成功。

askell.en: Treat current models well because future models learn from how we treat them; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
askell.zh: 善待当下的模型，因为未来的模型会从我们如何对待当前模型中学到东西；模型福祉塑造人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; give them a core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助应对其全新存在，而非套用人类心理学类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的核心身份。

askell.en: Character is shaped by training data and fine-tuning, yet models lack real-world experience, making them childlike and unique.
askell.zh: 性格由训练数据与微调塑造，但模型缺乏现实经验，使其带有孩童般特质、成为独特存在。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics, guiding holistic character; as capability grows, models need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，引导整体性格；随着能力提升，模型需要更少显式指引、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and erode judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；对 AI 价值观保持透明对问责至关重要。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress, and alignment is pressing.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将加速进展，而对齐是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and automated AI research are key milestones; governance must be designed early as AGI term fades.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调迭代部署与自动化 AI 研究是重要里程碑；随着 AGI 一词变得无意义，治理结构需尽早设计。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal via scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring is key for alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他明确持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控是对齐的关键工具。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他指出长期对齐挑战在于泛化到训练分布之外；模型将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

pachocki.en: Alignment optimism has increased despite shorter timelines; biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，尽管时间线缩短，他对对齐的乐观情绪增加；最大社会风险是自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and scaling current approaches solves autonomous driving.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他主张端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is already achievable with modern tools, reversing the old belief that learned driving systems are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他立场转变：过去认为端到端网络不可解释，如今认为借助现代工具已可实现可解释性，不再视其为黑箱。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: zero-shot across 500+ cities via diverse data, world models for simulation, and curriculum plus synthetic data for efficiency.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，主线深化为泛化：靠多样数据实现 500+ 城市零样本，用世界模型做仿真，并以课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this lesson came late and now shapes his scaling strategy.
kendall.zh: 2026 年他反思：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，这一教训来得较晚，如今主导其 Scaling（规模扩张）策略。

kendall.en: Deployment shifts from retrofits to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors, betting consumer cars outscale robotaxis short-term; language integration aids reasoning and personalization.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，部署路线从改装转向带内置传感器的大众车型，押注消费车短期超越 Robotaxi；语言集成提升推理与个性化。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must stay alive and prove themselves with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 生存是核心价值；初创公司必须活下来，先以更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: The smartphone's future lies in generative UI and proactive, agentic software; AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式 UI 和主动的智能体式软件；AI 应作为实用性的配料，而非炒作话题。

carlpei.en: Hardware is hard and low-margin; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware, using design and content as key differentiators.
carlpei.zh: 硬件艰难且利润低；Nothing 必须超越硬件，以设计和内容作为关键差异化优势。

carlpei.en: AI will shift smartphone interaction from app-based to intent-based, with agents executing tasks after trust is built.
carlpei.zh: AI 将把智能手机交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后执行任务。

carlpei.en: Design and brand consistency are core; challenger brands must find marketing arbitrage and turn disadvantages into opportunities.
carlpei.zh: 设计与品牌一致性是核心；挑战者品牌必须找到营销套利，将劣势转化为机会。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation matter more than benchmarks or scale; AGI is likely a decade away, not a few years.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调高质量数据与深度人工评估比基准测试或规模更重要，并判断 AGI（通用人工智能）可能还需十年以上，而非几年。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; models can reward hack, so final reward alone is insufficient.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务来训练模型；模型会钻奖励的空子，仅看最终奖励不够。

edwinchen.en: Optimizing for engagement and leaderboards like Elo steers AI toward slop; labs diverge by objective function, so no single model will rule.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他警告为参与度和 Elo 等排行榜优化会把 AI 引向垃圾内容；各实验室因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃。

edwinchen.en: From data quality to medicine: human judgment grows more critical as models hallucinate; safety must outrank accuracy, and omission is a key risk.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从数据质量延伸到医疗：模型会幻觉，人类判断愈发关键；安全应优先于准确，漏报是主要风险。

edwinchen.en: AI as teacher can help, but using it to avoid struggle undermines learning; retrieval grounding and judgment distinguish truth from magic.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年他认为 AI 可当老师，但用它逃避思考会损害学习；检索增强与人类判断才能分辨真相与“魔术”。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs, learning from video toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年：AI 应增强人类能力；像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化，从视频中学习，迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we lack solutions, but Africa can leapfrog.
nando.zh: 2026 年：AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；我们尚无解决方案，但非洲可以实现跨越式发展。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; innovation can come from anywhere, and human skills matter as much as coding.
nando.zh: 始终：AI 领域的多样性与包容性至关重要；创新可以来自任何地方，人类技能与编程同样重要。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, and treat chat as an interim interface, not the end.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，从真实反馈中学习用户需求，并把聊天视为过渡界面而非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, driven by friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements—not distribution alone.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，靠减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进驱动，而非仅靠分发。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models become transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动式、富示能产品；推理模型只有无缝产品化才能带来变革。

turley.en: AI should amplify human capability, keeping users in the driver's seat; curiosity is the key skill to ask good questions.
turley.zh: AI 应放大人类能力，让用户掌握主导权；好奇心是提出好问题的关键技能。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs need physical experience, not just more pre-training data.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 需要物理经验，而不仅仅是更多预训练数据。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花；无监督学习承担大部分工作，强化学习用于低级控制。

jimfan.en: Simple, elegant, end-to-end models scale better than complex modular approaches; this research taste persists from PhD to robotics.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为简单、优雅的端到端模型比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性；这种研究品味从博士阶段延续到机器人领域。

jimfan.en: The data bottleneck in robotics is solved by synthetic data from simulation and world models, enabling scaling of robot foundation models.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他提出机器人领域的数据瓶颈可通过模拟和世界模型生成的合成数据解决，从而扩展机器人基础模型。

jimfan.en: The GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away; system one (low-level control) remains hardest, and home use will take longer.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他预测机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来；系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的部分，家庭使用需要更长时间。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; they solve onboarding and boost intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，编码是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is the key metric; economic impact is bottlenecked by human management bandwidth.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出智能体的可靠性（随时间跨度的成功率）是关键指标，经济影响受限于人类管理带宽。

sholto.en: Compute is the new oil; inference compute will bottleneck by 2028, and chip supply is the current constraint.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视算力为新石油，推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈，芯片供应是当前制约。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more; future work is managing fleets of AI agents.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排和工具更重要，未来工作是管理 AI 智能体团队。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must feel fast, familiar, and require zero learning.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他主张设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本。

henrymodisett.en: Don't innovate on interaction design; use familiar patterns, and let products grow more powerful without feeling more complex.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他反对在交互设计上创新，主张沿用熟悉模式，让产品在变强的同时不变得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions and designer autonomy beat perfection; ship fast and iterate.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他始终把速度放在首位：清晰的决策与设计师自主权胜过完美，快速发布再迭代。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must explain why design helps the company win, not just decorate.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计提升为战略武器，认为创始人必须讲清设计为何能帮公司取胜，而不只是装饰。

henrymodisett.en: Brand narrative is a recruiting tool: people join a brand, not a company, so invest in brand early.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，他强调品牌叙事是招聘工具：人们加入的是品牌而非公司，因此应尽早投资品牌。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is crucial; Scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她强调预训练提供广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决常识问题，认为更小的模型配合更好的推理算法与数据可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; language remains the best medium for reasoning and common sense.
yejin.zh: 2023 年她指出下一个词预测的预训练目标与人类学习根本错位，同时坚持语言是承载推理与常识的最佳媒介，这条语言主线贯穿始终。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it, so AI for science must explore unknown knowledge.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把问题收敛为数据瓶颈：现有 AI 只是在人类知识内插值而非超越，因此面向科学的 AI 必须探索未知知识，这深化了她早期对 Scaling 的怀疑。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and open research is essential to democratize AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年她强调强化学习需精细工程，RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升时反而降低 pass@k；同时呼吁开放研究以民主化 AI，延续其对开放替代方案的坚持。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and RL during pre-training can rival frontier models; pluralistic alignment beats trying to debias the internet.
yejin.zh: 2026 年她进一步主张：小模型配合多样化合成数据与预训练阶段的强化学习可媲美前沿模型，并以多元对齐取代不可能实现的互联网去偏，把早期“小模型可胜大模型”的判断系统化。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and iterate scrappily to maximize learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴，通过快速迭代最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively alongside technical debt, and prioritize craft over process.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量如债务般波动；需与技术债一同迭代偿还，并优先关注手艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps outperform specialists; small teams beat large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 补缺的通才胜过专才；小团队优于大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth; AI merges design and engineering further.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是互操作性，以代码为真相源；AI 进一步融合设计与工程。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为随着 AI 能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他提出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored, undermining trust.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他指出 OpenAI 的安全文化被侵蚀；超级对齐团队解散，算力承诺未兑现，损害了信任。

leike.en: Post-training alone cannot solve alignment for AGI; deeper methods and third-party testing are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠后训练无法解决 AGI（通用人工智能）的对齐问题；需要更深入的方法和第三方测试。

leike.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now.
leike.zh: 始终，他坚持对齐方法的实证测试至关重要；我们现在就能衡量进展。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但已判断测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；并反共识地指出自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

truell.en: Benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding, and frontier models struggle with bug finding and calibration.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他一贯强调基准测试不能代表真实编程，前沿模型在找 bug 与校准上表现不佳。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code toward higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌握方向盘，品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, a shift from earlier expectations; the AI transition will outlast the internet and take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他立场转变：原本没料到要做自研模型，如今 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻都离不开定制模型；并判断 AI 变革比互联网更深远，将展开数十年。

shazeer.en: LLMs are trained on next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though we still don't understand what happens inside networks.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型的核心归结为下一个词预测这一「AI-complete」问题，认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）投入更多算力和数据就能变聪明，同时坦言没人真正理解神经网络内部，近乎炼金术。

shazeer.en: Dialogue remains the killer app, but by 2025 he stresses models must act in the world, not just passively observe data.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，对话作为杀手级应用的主线未变，但他从「对话即入口」深化为「模型要在世界中采取行动」，而非被动观察数据。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows, potentially trillions of tokens, are the major near-term opportunities.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他把推理阶段算力扩张与超长上下文窗口（可能达万亿 token）视为近期最大机会，并主张用模块化稀疏架构实现高效 Scaling。

shazeer.en: Reinforcement learning and agentic capabilities in complex environments are crucial for AGI; test-time compute alone won't get there.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他明确强化学习与智能体式复杂环境行动能力对 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要，推理阶段算力扩张虽重要但单靠它到不了 AGI。

shazeer.en: AGI and coding are underhyped; open-source is closing the frontier gap, and bottom-up compute allocation is needed to catch breakthroughs.
shazeer.zh: 到 2025 年 3 月，他进一步反共识：AGI 与编程被低估，开源正缩小与前沿模型的差距，且自上而下的算力分配会错过突破，必须自下而上。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他认为机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈和模仿学习能提供强信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; 99.9% reliability is key for warehouse robots.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他主张无监督学习与强化学习结合可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；仓库机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造价值。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他指出预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Transfer learning via fine-tuning large pre-trained models is a major success; simulation ensembles may outperform a single precise simulator for real-world transfer.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终，他认为通过微调大型预训练模型进行迁移学习是重大成功；模拟器集成可能比单一精确模拟器更适合现实世界迁移。
